name: Crucible Industries Cyclone-20 'Sandstorm'
description:
The Crucible Industries Cyclone-20 is a semi-automatic shotgun chambered in 20 gauge with a gas-operated action and a five-round detachable box magazine. The smaller 20-gauge chambering reduces recoil by approximately thirty percent compared to 12-gauge alternatives while maintaining effective close-range lethality, making the Cyclone accessible to shooters who find full-size combat shotguns unmanageable.

The Sandstorm fills a gap in Crucible's lineup between their pistol-caliber weapons and the full-size Storm-12. The 20-gauge round patterns slightly tighter than 12-gauge at equivalent distances, which can be an advantage in environments where collateral damage is a concern — hospital corridors, residential hallways, and other spaces where a 12-gauge buckshot spread might catch bystanders. Crucible markets this as 'precision shotgunning,' which is marketing hyperbole but contains a kernel of truth.

The weapon has found particular favor among security personnel who are assigned to sensitive facilities — medical centers, data archives, residential compounds — where the reduced noise, reduced recoil, and tighter pattern of 20-gauge are preferred over the raw power of 12-gauge. The Cyclone proves that a smaller shotgun shell, properly deployed, is more than adequate for most defensive scenarios.
specifications:
caliber: 20 gauge
effective_range: 30 meters (buckshot), 40 meters (slug)
rate_of_fire: Semi-automatic
magazine_capacity: 5 rounds (detachable box)
weight: 2.8 kg
tactical_use: A reduced-recoil semi-automatic shotgun for security applications where 12-gauge power is unnecessary or excessive. The 20-gauge round provides adequate close-range lethality with less noise, less recoil, and a tighter pattern. The semi-automatic action enables rapid follow-up shots. Suitable for sensitive-environment security where collateral damage and noise discipline matter.
cultural_context: The Sandstorm is the 'smart' shotgun choice — the weapon carried by security teams who have thought carefully about their environment and chosen capability appropriate to their actual threat profile rather than defaulting to maximum firepower. It represents a mature approach to armed security that values precision over power.
story_hooks: A Sandstorm loaded with experimental 20-gauge flechette rounds turns a routine security response into a massacre — the flechettes penetrate walls that buckshot wouldn't, hitting people in adjacent rooms.
Crucible Industries is producing a 20-gauge smart-round that steers itself toward the center of mass after leaving the barrel. The prototype is stolen before it enters production.

physical_description.visual_profile: A sleek, modern semi-automatic shotgun with a compact profile and refined lines. The Cyclone-20 presents as a scaled-down, purposeful security tool rather than a heavy combat weapon—elegant curves flow from the pistol grip through the receiver to a modest 51cm barrel. The overall impression is controlled precision rather than raw brutality.
physical_description.dimensions: Total length: 97cm | Barrel length: 51cm | Receiver width: 5.2cm | Height (over bore): 7.8cm
physical_description.weight_description: Balanced and manageable at 2.8kg—noticeably lighter than 12-gauge alternatives, sitting naturally in the hands without fatigue. The reduced inertia makes target transitions smooth and follow-up shots faster than heavier shotguns.
physical_description.primary_material: Forged aluminum receiver with steel barrel and internal components. Polymer furniture (handguard, magazine well) reinforced with carbon-fiber weave for durability.
physical_description.finish: Matte anodized aluminum with a gunmetal-gray tone. Steel barrel features a fine brushed finish with subtle corrosion-resistant coating. Polymer components have a textured, non-reflective matte black finish.
physical_description.color_scheme: Gunmetal gray receiver and barrel accented by matte black polymer. Subtle brushed-steel controls (safety lever, charging handle) provide tonal contrast. No bright colors or aesthetic chrome.
physical_description.grip_texture: Textured rubberized pistol grip with fine crosshatch pattern for positive purchase even with gloved hands. Polymer handguard features aggressive stippling. Magazine well has ribbed edges for sure insertion.
distinctive_features: Minimalist Picatinny rail section atop receiver (31mm length)
Integrated port sight (post) and shallow notch rear for emergency backup aiming
Subtle cooling vents along barrel shroud (functional aesthetic)
Ambidextrous safety lever with low-profile design
Magazine catch sits flush with trigger guard, reducing snag points
Charging handle integrated into the rear of the receiver bolt carrier
Muzzle break with four symmetrical ports (reduces recoil ~15% additional)
Serial number and Crucible Industries stamp on left side of lower receiver in sans-serif font
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: CRUCIBLE INDUSTRIES in block letters stamped on left side of receiver, 12mm height. 'CYCLONE-20' engraved below the rail in smaller font. Serial number plate (stainless steel insert) on trigger guard beneath receiver. 'SANDSTORM' variant designation laser-etched on magazine floorplate.
physical_description.condition_typical: Varies by operator tier: Tier 2 security maintains them pristine, with occasional light wear on grip texture. Field-deployed units show minor scuffing on handguard, worn finish on safety lever, and accumulated dust in cooling vents. Well-maintained weapons, rarely neglected due to their use in controlled environments.
